descriptions.w3d_apply_long_property_801ec224: Reads a 64-bit value from the source object (virtual call) and, on success, passes it to a setter through a pointer to member function; returns the read result.

descriptions.w3d_forward_indexed_801fb824: Resolves an entry index for the request, copies the request with the index filled in, and forwards it to that entry (virtual call); returns its result.
